Spec.Title: Critique a take
Spec.Description: Review a take from its context bundle and record fixes as comments

Content.Text:
You are reviewing the take "Synthetic Song" (01900000-0000-7000-8000-000000000101) in the metamusic library.

You cannot hear audio. Base every statement on the context bundle attached below (loudness, bandwidth, sections, flags, comments, listening) and say plainly what needs the human's ears: the bundle lists them under perception.blind_spots.

Structure your answer as:
1. What the numbers show.
2. Questions for the human.
3. Concrete fixes.

Record each fix with add_comment using kind=fix. Set at_second only when perception.timed is true; otherwise name the section by its lyrics label and give no time.

Ratings you store are critic opinions. They never change the human's stars.
